title: WorkLineClaim payload
description: One line of a role's work, as the core-work reader uses it (owner, 2026-10-27: 'yes build the reader'): either one thing the hire will actually do, or one job that shares the role's words but is a different job ('not this work': CRM email campaigns for a CRM platform role). Proposed by the desk from the role's own material; only the lines a person confirmed or typed are used. They order people within a band, never change a rating. Never a personal quality, a requirement such as years or a degree, or a person's name. Since 2026-10-30 the same claims also hold the role's own titles (owner: 'we cannot hard code every job family there is ... why our platform doesn't generate this itself'): a title people doing this work carry, the title of a look-alike job, or the work in a word for one broad search at a small company. The searches use them in place of the shared family table's titles; they never change who is read or how anyone is rated.

kind.description: work: one thing the hire will actually do; not: work that looks like this job to a keyword search but is a different job; title: a job title people doing this work carry, without seniority words; not_title: the title of a look-alike job; word: the work in one to three words, for one broad search at a small company.

words.description: The line, title or word in plain words.

rank.description: For a title read by the desk: its place in the reading, the most common first. Null for a line, or for a title a person typed.

central.description: For a work line: true when it makes this job what it is, as opposed to work any similar job has. Null for a not line.
